_about: The Podcast (studied from 5 Diary of a CEO shorts, ~/reels/references/TheDiaryOfACEO): moody, contrasty colour picture; 1-3 words at a time in heavy white caps at the lower third, key words in yellow (danger words in red), a group with a key word stacks small-over-big; the hook question in a white box with black caps and an arrowed name label; a pull quote in quotes in the same box mid-video; a Like button that gets clicked; a pinned show logo top-left; punch-ins every ~2 s; a low cinematic bed.

director.plan: core/scripts/podcast_plan.py <project> writes captions.keys/reds, the hook box (+ name label), a pull quote, the Like click and the show logo.
director.rules: Everything on screen is spoken, except the show logo and the name label (brand kit data). Footage stays in colour.
director.prep: Landscape two-shots: prep with SPEAKER_CROP=1 (scripts/speaker_crop.py) so the crop frames the person talking, not the nearest face.
